items.title: Ukraine: EU sanctions Russians over 'systematic unlawful deportation' of children
items.description: The EU is sanctioning 16 individuals and seven entities over alleged child abductions. The UK also issued fresh sanctions, and Germany's defense minister visited Kyiv amid a shaky ceasefire. DW has the latest.

items.title: EU needs to delay social media access for children - von der Leyen
items.description: She told an EU summit that an expert panel was due to come up with steps on how to protect minors online by July.

items.title: 'Britain at the heart of Europe': How Starmer's plans are going down in the EU
items.description: Sir Keir Starmer pledged to rebuild the UK's relationship with Europe in a defiant speech on Monday.

items.title: EU agrees sanctions on Israeli settlers over West Bank violence
items.description: The EU's foreign policy chief said "extremism and violence carry consequences", while Israel branded the move "arbitrary".

items.title: EU negotiators agree new rules on vital medicines
items.description: A new agreement aims to tackle the drug shortages that have plagued the bloc. Among other things, it would make it easier to use public funds to support the production of essential medicines.
